title: 心理学研究法
subtitle: Psychological Research Methods
educationalGoal: This course is designed to help students obtain fundamental knowledge on how to conduct psychological research. In this course we learn about the characteristics and background philosophy of four basic methods (experiments, observation, survey research, interviews) and the ethics of scientific research.
advice: This course is an introduction to methods of scientific psychological research. Students learn research methods (experiments, observation, survey research, and interviews) in psychology, and will gain information on not only technical aspects of each method, but also the philosophical background of each method and the ethics of psychological research. Classes consist of lectures and exercises on research methods. Students are required to actively participate in the exercises, understand the characteristics, and be able to apply the knowledge acquired to their own psychological research.
books: Materials would be introduced during the course.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of psychology acquired in the “Introduction to Psychology” course is required.
